tldr: For known outcome lag \(D\), put \(L=D+1\). The proved finite-horizon original-feedback minimax regret profiles are \(Lq\log(1+Tq/L)\) for chronological-prefix deficit tables and \(Lq^2\log(1+T/L)\) for per-unit deficit tables, with universal all-policy lower bounds and one attaining anytime design supplied only the lag. The comparison is final raw Horvitz--Thompson variance against the empirical best constant Bernoulli allocation. The prefix value equals \(T(1-\sqrt{1-q})^2\) throughout \(Tq\le L\); at no feedback this is the exact value for both classes. The note also evaluates the joint regimes preserving immediate-feedback order. A separate corollary transfers a lower bound to the normalized Noarov class, without claiming an upper frontier there. The contribution is a specialist delayed extension of credited immediate laws and generic allocation and delay machinery.
